answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a public beacon chain: every epoch the agent publishes a hash of its recent trades to an external ledger, paying a small real fee, like a vine sending one tendril into foreign soil. The anchor is timestamped and cannot be backdated, so a fake cannot wander in late and claim a long history. A sybil farmer must pay the anchoring fee and build a real dated record for every fake, while one honest agent anchors once per epoch cheaply. Forged histories die at the beacon: no anchor, no standing.
